data.narrative:
Ocius Technology is a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by Robert Dane, with $176M in total capital raised anchored by an Australian Program of Record contract awarded in March 2026. The peer universe comprises 10 comparable companies: 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Defense Unicorns, and Heven AeroTech.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applied a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the $176M capital-raised baseline, yielding $334M. Peer-median methodology benchmarked against 6 same-sector, same-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $300M to $3.0B, producing a median implied value of $1.1B. The wide peer range ($300M–$3.0B) reflects material heterogeneity in growth trajectory and contract maturity within the defense-tech cohort.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $284M (low), $730M (median), and $1.3B (high). The gap between stage-progression and peer-median results—$334M versus $1.1B—reflects uncertainty around whether Ocius commands a premium or discount relative to established Series B peers. Key variables affecting placement within this range include the scope and exclusivity of the Australian Program of Record, revenue run-rate relative to contract value, and competitive positioning within the defense-security vertical.
